message: until without a timeout can block forever
why: The workflow's bounds are step counts, not wall-clock time. An until with no timeout has no upper bound the compiler can see, so one missing emit hangs the artifact while the cost model still reports a finite run.
fix: if the wait is genuinely meant to be unbounded, keep it and make sure an emit is guaranteed.
